testcase.name: finds are not filtered by draft state - this dispatch does not decide entries-vs-drafts curation
a find at 11-59pm local belongs to that evening's trip, not the next day's
an offline region downloaded that day is included, without live tile-status fields it cannot honestly have
a track from 10pm to 1am appears in both days' derived trips
a waypoint dropped just after local midnight on a DST transition day is bucketed into that transition day
a day with no data at all succeeds with every list empty, not a failure
